help:
usage: wikiskill [-h] [--version]
                 {collection,log,suite,eval,build,install,hook,guard,note,corrections,compare,leaderboard,review,sample,refine,proposal,graph} ...

Trace what skills and subagents do with a model, across harnesses.

positional arguments:
  {collection,log,suite,eval,build,install,hook,guard,note,corrections,compare,leaderboard,review,sample,refine,proposal,graph}
    collection          declare and check watched collections
    log                 inspect the raw event log
    suite               validate task suites
    eval                run a task suite in fresh isolated headless sessions
    build               generate a harness layout from the neutral source
    install             install built components and the harness logger
    hook                (Claude Code) log one hook event read from stdin;
                        always exits 0, silently
    guard               (evaluation, Claude Code) refuse a tool call a task
                        denies; reads a PreToolUse event
    note                record an explicit note on what a skill or agent got
                        wrong, in its session
    corrections         find correction signals outside a session
    compare             compare two runs of one suite across versions of a
                        component
    leaderboard         pool runs of one suite, from any machines, per model
                        and condition
    review              distil one component's evidence into wiki patterns
    sample              take and keep a review sample, for a maintainer that
                        runs elsewhere
    refine              propose one patch to one component; never applies it
    proposal            list, show, apply, replay and decide proposals
    graph               build and read the collection's relation graph

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit

usage: wikiskill collection [-h] {init,show,check} ...

positional arguments:
  {init,show,check}
    init             write a manifest for a source directory
    show             print a manifest as resolved
    check            resolve sources and the watch list

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit

usage: wikiskill collection init [-h] --source DIR
                                 [--layout {opencode,claude-plugin}] [--force]
                                 name

positional arguments:
  name

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --source DIR
  --layout {opencode,claude-plugin}
  --force               overwrite an existing manifest

usage: wikiskill collection show [-h] [--json] name

positional arguments:
  name

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --json      print the logger's runtime view

usage: wikiskill collection check [-h] [--sync] name

positional arguments:
  name

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --sync      also publish the logger's runtime configuration

usage: wikiskill log [-h] {validate,stats,tail} ...

positional arguments:
  {validate,stats,tail}
    validate            validate every log against the raw event schema
    stats               summarise a collection's raw log
    tail                print the most recent events

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

usage: wikiskill log validate [-h] [--raw-dir RAW_DIR] [--limit LIMIT] name

positional arguments:
  name               collection name

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --raw-dir RAW_DIR  override the raw log location
  --limit LIMIT

usage: wikiskill log stats [-h] [--raw-dir RAW_DIR] name

positional arguments:
  name               collection name

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --raw-dir RAW_DIR  override the raw log location

usage: wikiskill log tail [-h] [--raw-dir RAW_DIR] [-n COUNT] [-f] [--json]
                          name

positional arguments:
  name               collection name

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --raw-dir RAW_DIR  override the raw log location
  -n, --count COUNT
  -f, --follow
  --json

usage: wikiskill suite [-h] {check} ...

positional arguments:
  {check}
    check     validate a suite and flag prompts that name their own expected
              route

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

usage: wikiskill suite check [-h] file [file ...]

positional arguments:
  file        task suite file

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

usage: wikiskill eval [-h] --suite SUITE [--harness {opencode,claude-code}]
                      [--collection COLLECTION] [--models MODEL [MODEL ...]]
                      [--condition CONDITION] [--task TASK]
                      [--split {train,val,test}] [--base-url URL]
                      [--api-key-env API_KEY_ENV] [--min-context MIN_CONTEXT]
                      [--probe-timeout SECONDS] [--max-output-tokens N]
                      [--thinking {default,off,on}] [--proposal PROPOSAL]
                      [--no-seed-cache] [--workers N] [--preflight-only]
                      [--opencode OPENCODE] [--claude CLAUDE]
                      [--foreground-agents]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --suite SUITE         task suite file
  --harness {opencode,claude-code}
                        the harness each unit runs in (default opencode)
  --collection COLLECTION
                        collection under test (required for ROUTED)
  --models MODEL [MODEL ...]
                        provider/model strings, or aliases from the manifest
                        (default: its opencode targets)
  --condition CONDITION
                        comma-separated: off, routed, injected (default
                        off,routed)
  --task TASK           run only this task id
  --split {train,val,test}
                        split to place tasks in when the fixture declares
                        none, as data-science-harness's `bench/tasks` do not
                        (default val)
  --base-url URL        endpoint serving the models under test: OpenAI-
                        compatible for OpenCode, e.g.
                        http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama, or Anthropic-
                        compatible for Claude Code, e.g.
                        http://localhost:11434. Omit it when the harness
                        serves the model itself
  --api-key-env API_KEY_ENV
                        environment variable holding its API key
  --min-context MIN_CONTEXT
                        minimum context window preflight accepts; 0 skips the
                        check
  --probe-timeout SECONDS
                        how long preflight's tool-call probe may take, model
                        loading included (default 120 against --base-url, 300
                        through the harness)
  --max-output-tokens N
                        tokens one model turn may generate, thinking included,
                        against --base-url (default 8192). Recorded in
                        run.json
  --thinking {default,off,on}
                        ask the model to think (on) or not (off), against
                        --base-url; default leaves it to the model, and models
                        differ. Recorded in run.json, and never pooled across
                        settings
  --proposal PROPOSAL   evaluate this refinement proposal's candidate, from a
                        copy of its source in the run directory; the source
                        itself is never written
  --no-seed-cache       download OpenCode's packages, ripgrep and model
                        catalog into every unit, rather than copying them from
                        this machine's seed under ~/.cache/wikiskill/opencode-
                        seed/
  --workers N           units to run at once against one endpoint (default 1,
                        which is what Ollama serves). Models still run one
                        after another
  --preflight-only      check each model and stop, without running the suite
  --opencode OPENCODE   path to the opencode executable
  --claude CLAUDE       path to the claude executable
  --foreground-agents   (claude-code) run every subagent in the foreground,
                        even when the model asks for the background. Recorded
                        in run.json

usage: wikiskill build [-h] --harness {opencode,claude-code}
                       [--collection COLLECTION] [--out OUT]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --harness {opencode,claude-code}
  --collection COLLECTION
                        build this collection's own sources, with its alias
                        table, instead of wikiskill's
  --out OUT             output directory (default dist/<harness>)

usage: wikiskill install [-h] --harness {opencode,claude-code}
                         --scope {global,project} [--collection COLLECTION]
                         [--target TARGET] [--uninstall] [--force]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --harness {opencode,claude-code}
  --scope {global,project}
  --collection COLLECTION
  --target TARGET       override the harness config directory
  --uninstall           remove exactly what was installed
  --force               on uninstall, remove changed files too

usage: wikiskill hook [-h] [event]

positional arguments:
  event       e.g. PostToolUse

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

usage: wikiskill guard [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

usage: wikiskill note [-h] [--component COMPONENT] [--session SESSION]
                      [--collection COLLECTION]
                      text [text ...]

positional arguments:
  text                  the note, as you would say it

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --component COMPONENT
                        the component it is about, e.g. preregister or
                        agent:datalad-doer (default: the session's last
                        activated)
  --session SESSION     the session it is about (default: the most recent
                        logged one in this directory)
  --collection COLLECTION
                        only this collection (default: every one logging it)

usage: wikiskill corrections [-h] {scan} ...

positional arguments:
  {scan}
    scan      record edits made to files a watched component wrote, since it
              wrote them

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

usage: wikiskill corrections scan [-h] [--collection COLLECTION] [--quiet]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --collection COLLECTION
                        only this collection (default: every one)
  --quiet               print nothing and always succeed (for the loggers)

usage: wikiskill compare [-h] --collection COLLECTION [--component COMPONENT]
                         [--record {accept,reject}] [--proposal PROPOSAL]
                         [--note NOTE]
                         run_a run_b

positional arguments:
  run_a                 the earlier run: an id under the collection's evals,
                        or a path
  run_b                 the later run

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --collection COLLECTION
  --component COMPONENT
                        the component under test (default: inferred)
  --record {accept,reject}
                        record these runs as the proposal's replay and this
                        decision in the wiki's skill-impact.md; nothing is
                        applied or reverted
  --proposal PROPOSAL   the proposal id the decision is about
  --note NOTE           the reviewer's note for --record

usage: wikiskill leaderboard [-h] [--collection COLLECTION] [--out OUT]
                             run [run ...]

positional arguments:
  run                   a run directory, or a run id under --collection's
                        evals

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --collection COLLECTION
                        where to find runs given by id
  --out OUT             output directory (default: under the collection's
                        evals)

usage: wikiskill review [-h] --collection COLLECTION [--run RUN]
                        [--budget BUDGET] [--signals SIGNALS] [--clean CLEAN]
                        [--resample] [--retries RETRIES] [--dry-run]
                        [--reply-file REPLY_FILE] [--sample SAMPLE]
                        component

positional arguments:
  component             e.g. datalad/datalad-doer

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --collection COLLECTION
  --run RUN             only this run (default: every run of it)
  --budget BUDGET       prompt characters (default 15000, less for a
                        maintainer whose `context_tokens` is under 64k)
  --signals SIGNALS     most pieces of evidence with a correction or failure
                        signal
  --clean CLEAN         most pieces of evidence with no signal
  --resample            include evidence earlier reviews were shown
  --retries RETRIES
  --dry-run             print the prompt and stop
  --reply-file REPLY_FILE
                        validate and apply a maintainer reply written
                        elsewhere, e.g. in-harness
  --sample SAMPLE       the `wikiskill sample` id (or directory) the --reply-
                        file answers

usage: wikiskill sample [-h] --collection COLLECTION [--run RUN]
                        [--budget BUDGET] [--signals SIGNALS] [--clean CLEAN]
                        [--resample]
                        component

positional arguments:
  component             e.g. datalad/datalad-doer

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --collection COLLECTION
  --run RUN             only this run (default: every run of it)
  --budget BUDGET       prompt characters (default 15000, less for a
                        maintainer whose `context_tokens` is under 64k)
  --signals SIGNALS     most pieces of evidence with a correction or failure
                        signal
  --clean CLEAN         most pieces of evidence with no signal
  --resample            include evidence earlier reviews were shown

usage: wikiskill refine [-h] --collection COLLECTION [--retries RETRIES]
                        [--budget BUDGET] [--dry-run] [--prepare]
                        [--prompt PROMPT] [--reply-file REPLY_FILE]
                        [--allow-overlap]
                        component

positional arguments:
  component             e.g. datalad/datalad-doer

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --collection COLLECTION
  --retries RETRIES
  --budget BUDGET       characters of evidence in the prompt
  --dry-run             print the prompt and stop
  --prepare             persist the prompt for a proposer run elsewhere, e.g.
                        in-harness, and stop
  --prompt PROMPT       the --prepare id (or directory) the --reply-file
                        answers
  --reply-file REPLY_FILE
                        validate a proposer reply written elsewhere
  --allow-overlap       accept text the leakage check matched; recorded with
                        the proposal

usage: wikiskill proposal [-h] {list,show,apply,replay,decide} ...

positional arguments:
  {list,show,apply,replay,decide}
    list                every proposal, its state and recommendation
    show                print a proposal's preview and replay
    apply               say how to apply a proposal; write only with --branch
    replay              compare a baseline and a candidate run, recommend
    decide              record the decision in skill-impact.md

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

usage: wikiskill proposal list [-h] --collection COLLECTION

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --collection COLLECTION

usage: wikiskill proposal show [-h] --collection COLLECTION id

positional arguments:
  id                    e.g. p-001

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --collection COLLECTION

usage: wikiskill proposal apply [-h] [--branch] --collection COLLECTION id

positional arguments:
  id                    e.g. p-001

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --branch              commit it on a new branch wikiskill/<component>/<id>
                        of the source repository
  --collection COLLECTION

usage: wikiskill proposal replay [-h] [--tolerance TOLERANCE]
                                 --collection COLLECTION
                                 id baseline candidate

positional arguments:
  id                    e.g. p-001
  baseline              a run at the proposal's source_hash
  candidate             a run with `wikiskill eval --proposal <id>`

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --tolerance TOLERANCE
                        how far one task's pass rate may fall on one model
                        (default 1/3)
  --collection COLLECTION

usage: wikiskill proposal decide [-h] [--note NOTE] --collection COLLECTION
                                 id {accept,reject,withdraw}

positional arguments:
  id                    e.g. p-001
  {accept,reject,withdraw}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --note NOTE           why
  --collection COLLECTION

usage: wikiskill graph [-h] {build,show,neighbours} ...

positional arguments:
  {build,show,neighbours}
    build               rebuild graph.json from the sources and eval runs, and
                        commit it
    show                print the stored graph
    neighbours          a component's depth-1 neighbours

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

usage: wikiskill graph build [-h] [--run RUN] --collection COLLECTION

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --run RUN             read only this run (repeatable; default every run of
                        the collection)
  --collection COLLECTION

usage: wikiskill graph show [-h] [--json] --collection COLLECTION

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --json
  --collection COLLECTION

usage: wikiskill graph neighbours [-h] [--min-conflict MIN_CONFLICT]
                                  --collection COLLECTION
                                  component

positional arguments:
  component

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --min-conflict MIN_CONFLICT
                        smallest confusion rate that makes a neighbour
                        (default 0.05)
  --collection COLLECTION
